column3: BootUI names the authenticated principal from Spring Security. sharpit reads scope["user"] as plain data and never runs a property, descriptor or __getattr__: Starlette's SimpleUser, or a subclass that keeps its is_authenticated and display_name, gives its username; UnauthenticatedUser gives none; any other user is named only when is_authenticated is exactly True and display_name exactly a str, both plain attributes or __slots__ fields. A computed name, a str subclass or a truthy non-bool flag gives no principal.
